events.title: Orionids Meteor Shower – Meteors & Midnight Magic
events.description:
Join the stargazing camping near Bangalore for an unforgettable experience under the stars with expert guidance.

About the Event

*EVENT SUBJECTED TO WEATHER*

PLEASE READ OUR CANCELLATIONS AND REFUND POLICIES CAREFULLY BEFORE YOU BOOK.

Cancellation Policies – Bangalore Astronomy Club

*BANGALORE ASTRONOMY CLUB PRESENTS*
_

__Orionids Meteor Shower & Stargazing Camping Event.
__Experience Big telescope/unmatched views under professional guidance.
__Evening Snacks, Dinner & Breakfast with stay in Tents or Rooms.

*Date:*
__Oct. 20-21, 2026 (Tuesday Night)

*Timings:*
__Reach Farm at: 04:00 PM on Day-1
__Leave Farm at: 9:30 AM on Day-2

*Location:*
Chiguru Farm:
https://maps.app.goo.gl/Pt4YdP23jHGeunMM9

*5 Stay Options*

*Itinerary:*

*Day-1:*
_Reach Chiguru Farm around 4:00 pm. in your own vehicles.
_Solar Astronomy Session, Sunspots etc.
_Tents Pitch-in
_Group Photo with Telescopes and Tents in Background
_Snacks with Tea-Coffee
_Visit Sunset point
_Astronomy QUIZ for kids and adults
_Understand Astronomy Basics, Telescopes, Space & cameras etc.
_Evening stargazing session
_Dinner
_Bonefire
_Understanding of Night Sky, stars and constellations
_Learn to identify objects in Night Sky
_Stargazing with HIGH END AUTOMATIC BIG TELESCOPE & Visual astronomy with Moon, Planets, Nebulas, Galaxies, Star Clusters etc.
_Meteors Watch, lying on ground on insulated mats.
_Sleep in tents or Rooms as per your bookings

*Day-2:*
_Wake-up early morning for Morning Stargazing session (Optional).
_Visit Sunrise Point
_Morning Tea-Coffee
_Unpack tents
_Breakfast
_Departure, on way back enjoying scenic drive of Bilikal forest.

Pre-Booking with full payment is mandatory for the event.
